test_reorder_levels: test the pandas DataFrame.reorder_levels method to reorder MultiIndex levels by position or label
test_reorder_levels_swaplevel_equivalenc: test that reorder_levels produces equivalent results to chaining swaplevel calls on a MultiIndex DataFrame
test_reorder_levels_no_change_position: test that reorder_levels with the same level order returns an unchanged DataFrame
test_reorder_levels_no_change_labels: test that reorder_levels with the same level labels returns an unchanged DataFrame
test_reorder_levels_duplicate_levels: test that reorder_levels accepts duplicate level references and duplicates the corresponding levels
